prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exceptionally polished desktop website design comp, 1536x1024 landscape: a real web layout, edge to edge, no device frame, no browser chrome.

The attached reference images are screenshots of the SAME website's already-built pages. Carry over exactly: the header (script wordmark "Birdcar" at left; nav "How I work", "Selected work", "Writing" and a canary-yellow pill "Book a free Walkthrough →"), the pale daylight ground #edf3f0, near-black ink #0b141a, the heavy tight grotesk (Mona Sans) for all text, white cards with soft offset shadows, white pill tags, canary yellow #f7c848 only on actions and small highlights, and the premium matte isometric miniature render style. Do NOT copy any reference's page content beyond what this prompt names.

This page is "Eight ways work gets stuck": a free field guide from Nick (Birdcar). It names the eight patterns he uses in his Walkthrough reports so an owner can recognize their own week, then book a free Walkthrough. The eight pattern names, exactly: 1 "It runs on remembering", 2 "The same information, typed twice", 3 "Nobody trusts the numbers", 4 "Assembled by hand", 5 "Waiting on a reply", 6 "Only one person knows how", 7 "Waiting on your yes", 8 "The workaround became the process". The visitor's job: recognize a few, read those entries, book a Walkthrough.

STRUCTURE, in reading order (one business, eight hotspots: the first attached reference's miniature business is the map):
1. Header, about 80px, as the reference.
2. First viewport, two columns. LEFT (x 80 to 600): headline about 64px across three lines: "Eight ways work gets stuck. Most businesses have a few." A lead at about 20px: "Most of the work that ends up on your desk isn't hard because it's complicated. It's hard in a handful of familiar ways." Then the canary-yellow button "Book a free Walkthrough →" and a small muted line "A pitch-free hour. A written report within three business days. Yours to keep."
RIGHT (x 620 to 1500, y 90 to 980): the dominant object, the SAME premium matte isometric cutaway diorama of a small service business as in the first reference (van bay, open office with desks, front desk, glass owner's office with a paper stack and a small red warning light, a canary in a cage). Over it, eight small numbered white circular pins (1 to 8, bold ink numerals), each placed on the spot where that pattern shows up (for example 7 on the owner's desk, 5 at the front desk, 4 at a desk with a report, 2 between two desks with monitors), each pin paired with a white pill tag carrying that pattern's exact name. Faint dotted canary routes run from a few pins toward the owner's desk.
3. Bottom band (y 990 to 1024): the top edge of the next section on white.

ART DIRECTION: one dominant move, the diorama as a map of the eight patterns; the left column holds still. Premium, adult, precise. Not cute. No purple, no gradient orbs, no robots, no AI imagery, no stock photos, no numbers or results, no testimonials. Preserve all quoted words exactly. Treat it as a finished, shippable website.
